about: Magnet rules, shared by the TypeScript tests (packages/core) and the Kotlin commonTest (apps/mobile). Requests are in the readers' shape (magnets/readers.ts). Card sizes use the formatter: null reads UNKNOWN; otherwise bytes / 1024^3 with two decimals under 10 and one from 10 up, then " GB".

readerAccepted.case: a ready film with its files, links rebuilt
files on a request not ready are ignored
a series keeps episode numbers and ignores unknown fields
a poster off TMDB and an empty year are left out
a name is cleaned and cut
